question: After the concrete blockers are repaired, should OpenClaw ship the full bundled Workspaces feature including agent-authored custom widgets?
rationale: The protected maintainer label and permanent ownership of an unauthenticated asset route plus sandboxed browser-code capability require explicit product intent that automated review cannot determine.

options.title: Ship full opt-in Workspaces
options.body: Accept the bundled feature after all correctness, security, conflict, lifecycle, and proof gates pass.

options.title: Land trusted workspaces first
options.body: Remove custom widgets from this PR and initially ship only persistent workspace composition with built-in widgets.

options.title: Keep Workspaces external
options.body: Move the capability to an external plugin if maintainers do not want to own the long-term sandbox and asset-serving boundary.

recommendation.title: Ship full opt-in Workspaces
recommendation.body: Accept the bundled feature after all correctness, security, conflict, lifecycle, and proof gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The live assignee and integration owner is the clearest available owner for the bundled product decision.
